selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP 8181
selected_evidence.summary: Apache configuration uses port 8181; the listener is active; direct requests to node1 return HTTP 200 and the Inventory Application content.
SELinux is Enforcing, TCP 8181 is labeled http_port_t, application content is correctly labeled, and Apache processes run in httpd_t.

selected_evidence.requirement: Permit access through the host firewall
selected_evidence.summary: TCP 8181 is allowed in both runtime and permanent firewalld configuration, including after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 remained unchanged; Apache 2.4.62 is the Red Hat-provided RHEL 9 package.
